lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple vertical columns of high-luminance circular pixel clusters. Central flank area exhibits vertical groupings of 3 to 4 spots aligned within light-intensity vertical bands.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a repetitive grid across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Horizontal linear feature running through the mid-section of the flank, characterized by a distinct vertical intensity gradient with higher pixel values on the dorsal side and lower on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Small, discrete high-luminance clusters scattered across the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin's silhouette, primarily along the leading edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Non-linear, convoluted light-intensity patterns (vermiculated lines) located in the anterior dorsal region, between the gill slits and the primary dorsal fin.
